text:
Ava Brooks: opened PR #712 to unify how we surface usage units across the pricing page, quota docs, and the dashboard export. Main changes: rename `X-RW-Usage-Tokens` -> `X-RW-Usage-Units`, add a short mapping table for tiers, and replace the demo Grafana panel to use the namespaced metric. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712
Tom Wu: nice. can you paste the exact new header names so I can update the SDK examples?
Ava Brooks: new headers: `X-RW-Usage-Units`, `X-RW-Usage-Remaining`, `X-RW-Usage-Window-UTC`. Old `X-Usage-*` names are deprecated for 21 days.
Jordan Miller: adding Python + TS snippet now. Python draft:
```python
resp = client.generate(prompt)
units_left = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Usage-Remaining') or resp.headers.get('X-Usage-Remaining')
units_total = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Usage-Units') or resp.headers.get('X-Usage-Units')
print(f"usage: {units_left}/{units_total} units")
```
Jordan Miller: TS draft mirrors that with `resp.headers.get(...) || resp.headers.get(...)`.
Sofia Alvarez: on dashboards  the exported panel referenced `$orgId` but our public example dashboards use `$workspace`. I updated the panel JSON in the PR to use `$workspace` and put it under `/assets/grafana/panels/usage_by_workspace.json`. Also changed legend label to `Usage (rw_usage_units_total)`.
Ava Brooks: thanks Sofia. Can you also add a short caption in the docs page: "Metric name: rw_usage_units_total" so readers don't copy the old metric name?
Sofia Alvarez: done and pushed. I attached a hi-res screenshot showing the updated legend and variable.
Tom Wu: small note for SDKs: our header helper lowercases keys in Node and Python, so mention headers are case-insensitive. I'll add a one-line note under each snippet.
Jordan Miller: added the note and a fallback example for older headers: `resp.headers.get('x-rw-usage-remaining') || resp.headers.get('x-usage-remaining')`.
Ava Brooks: migration guide  let's add a quick diff and a troubleshooting bullet: "If headers are missing, check gateway passthrough and any CDN rules that strip custom headers."
Tom Wu: added CDN note and a brief backoff suggestion for 429s: check `Retry-After` header and use exponential jitter. 
DeployBot: PR #712 status changed: reviewers requested @tom, @sofia, @jordan.
Jordan Miller: requested one tiny change  update the pricing table footnote to show header names in parentheses next to "Monthly allowance" so product can map numbers to headers.
Ava Brooks: done. One last spellcheck and I'll merge after CI green. Targeting merge today. :rocket:
Tom Wu: approved.
Sofia Alvarez: approved (image and panel JSON look good).
DeployBot: PR #712 merged by Ava Brooks.
Ava Brooks: merged. I'll post a short note in #docs and add an item to the internal migration tracker for infra to monitor header usage for the next 21 days. Thanks all! :tada:
